title: SKE Crystal Fruit Medley Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Fruit Medley flavour from SKE Crystal Nic Salts e-liquid offers a delicious burst of mixed fruit flavours, combining an assortment of fresh, ripe summer fruits for a rich and vibrant vaping experience. Perfect for vapers who crave a variety of fruit flavours, this e-liquid provides a satisfying mix of sweetness and tanginess. The inclusion of nicotine salts ensures a smoother inhalation compared to traditional e-liquids, suitable for those who prefer a gentle throat hit. The 50VG/50PG ratio of this e-liquid is optimized for mouth-to-lung vaping, providing excellent flavour while maintaining good cloud production. It's an ideal choice for those using starter kits and pod systems who enjoy a flavourful and refreshing vape. SKE are the creators of the hugely popular SKE Crystal Bar 600 disposable vape, a super-convenient single-use vape bar encased in a dazzling crystal chassis. SKE have since expanded their range with the SKE Crystal Plus pre-filled pod kit as well as this ever-evolving collection of Nicotine Salt 10ml e-liquids for use with many kinds of vape kit.
